why: The lifecycle runs' one machine (e2e.yml with lifecycle on, WORKLIST P0.86): every flow in .maestro/lifecycle, each changing the phone mid-flow, which run-flows.sh puts back before the next. Read by e2e/shards.mjs and run-flows.sh; shards.test.ts holds it to the folder.
probesElsewhere: The keyboard probes and the launch with animations run in the normal rounds (e2e/shards.json); a lifecycle run tests what the phone does to the app, not them.
